exam.title: AI Business Professional
exam.study_prerequisites: Basic Microsoft 365 business-user experience in Outlook, Word, Teams, PowerPoint and Excel plus hands-on use of Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts, conversations, agents, Researcher, Analyst, Pages and Notebooks; no coding or app-development experience is required.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Manage prompts and conversations by using AI
Draft and analyze business content by using AI

review.notes: Every July 22, 2026 subobjective is mapped to an outcome, experience/context choice, prompt/source contract, permission/protection boundary, responsible-AI risk, verification step, reuse/collaboration decision, evidence, or human approval. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 original checks cover work/web/app context and Graph permissions; chat, agents, Researcher, Analyst, Pages and Notebooks; fabrication, injection, over-reliance, sensitive data and protection restrictions; prompt design/reference/iteration/save/schedule/share; conversation and notebook lifecycle; Agent Store and template/knowledge/instructions/capabilities/suggested prompts/sharing; documents, summaries, cross-app flows, meetings, collaboration, memory and instructions. All 11 URLs are cataloged: 10 reachable and Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The guide records the active 45-minute exam, 4h31 official path, one-day course, free Practice Assessment, official prep video, current developing Pluralsight path, O'Reilly live course, MeasureUp and Udemy assessments, partner learning, and no exact verified Whizlabs product. September 27, 2026: registered and checked citations for the bounded update; link counts reconciled. This does not renew the historical full-guide or blueprint review.

findings.title: October adds a fourth agent domain
findings.evidence: Current October objectives explicitly require model selection, connectors, visual outputs, meeting tools, agent history and Cowork.
findings.recommendation: Map every bullet and expand dated preparation without accepting the future baseline early.
findings.resolution: Map every bullet and expand dated preparation without accepting the future baseline early.

findings.title: Model choices have app and policy scope
findings.evidence: Auto, Quick response and Think deeper address different task needs; available providers and grounding depend on the experience.
findings.recommendation: Add selection and same-evidence comparison, with Researcher and Excel boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add selection and same-evidence comparison, with Researcher and Excel boundaries.

findings.title: Live retrieval and indexed retrieval have different freshness
findings.evidence: Synced connectors index source content; federated retrieval is live, currently read-only with write actions announced for early October.
findings.recommendation: Add troubleshooting and missing-evidence reasoning; schedule rollout verification.
findings.resolution: Add troubleshooting and missing-evidence reasoning; schedule rollout verification.

findings.title: Notebook sharing can invite recipients to linked files
findings.evidence: Sharing a notebook can invite recipients to linked files the sharer can share; grounding scope and reference limits are distinct.
findings.recommendation: Add source-scope guidance and synthetic plan/compensation example and lab.
findings.resolution: Add source-scope guidance and synthetic plan/compensation example and lab.

findings.title: Personalization has multiple sources
findings.evidence: Saved memory, chat/work inferences and instructions differ; temporary chat does not override organizational retention.
findings.recommendation: Add separate controls and history deletion timing caveat.
findings.resolution: Add separate controls and history deletion timing caveat.

findings.title: Meeting tools have different audiences and task behavior
findings.evidence: Facilitator publishes shared notes and has meeting-type/license limits; task features have preview and sync distinctions.
findings.recommendation: Add meeting comparison, note-editability and task acceptance boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add meeting comparison, note-editability and task acceptance boundaries.

findings.title: Live catch-up does not imply a complete saved transcript
findings.evidence: Only-during mode can use transient speech; post-meeting spoken-content questions need a transcript.
findings.recommendation: Add capture/retention distinction and 40-minute/20-minute evidence example.
findings.resolution: Add capture/retention distinction and 40-minute/20-minute evidence example.

findings.title: Recap features and sharing depend on capture and access
findings.evidence: Intelligent recap license, transcript language/length and recording requirements differ; explicit sharing and copying a link have different effects.
findings.recommendation: Add feature prerequisites and recipient/source verification.
findings.resolution: Add feature prerequisites and recipient/source verification.

findings.title: Cowork approval scope can exceed one displayed action
findings.evidence: Session approvals may skip later prompts; editing an existing Office file changes that shared file.
findings.recommendation: Add approval-scope example and disposable-file/version-history lab.
findings.resolution: Add approval-scope example and disposable-file/version-history lab.

findings.title: Automation preauthorization and spending access are separate controls
findings.evidence: Automated tasks can have preauthorized actions; small spending limits still grant access and model settings do not revoke Cowork service access.
findings.recommendation: Add schedule/action review and budget-versus-access distinction.
findings.resolution: Add schedule/action review and budget-versus-access distinction.

findings.title: Shared skills have a version and trust boundary
findings.evidence: A skill supplies instructions and can be edited/shared; updates need Re-share and should be tested in a new conversation.
findings.recommendation: Add built-in/custom decision, source review and new-session testing; distinguish automated evaluation from certified correctness.
findings.resolution: Add built-in/custom decision, source review and new-session testing; distinguish automated evaluation from certified correctness.

findings.title: Browser execution uses a local signed-in identity
findings.evidence: Supported Edge and tenant enablement are required; desktop/mobile app route is unsupported and user handoffs handle credentials/human checks.
findings.recommendation: Add execution-surface and account verification without treating cloud permission as universal browser support.
findings.resolution: Add execution-surface and account verification without treating cloud permission as universal browser support.

findings.title: Linked Learn path changed module inventory
findings.evidence: Public path now lists Enhance business workflows with AI and four modules including Cowork rather than the previous six-module listing.
findings.recommendation: Update guide and source catalog; withdraw current-duration and full-scope claims.
findings.resolution: Update guide and source catalog; withdraw current-duration and full-scope claims.

offline_checks: Eight synthetic gross/net, capture-duration, reference-set and course-duration assertions; no app or permission execution

limitations: July 22 accepted baseline retained; all 41 October 20 objectives separately mapped. Product previews do not add exam objectives.

No Microsoft 365 tenant, paid lesson, signed-in Practice Assessment, sharing, agent, Cowork, meeting, browser or scheduled-task execution. All ten labs remain learner exercises; eight arithmetic/set assertions are offline only.

The October objective requires filtering chats by agent, but reviewed public history documentation does not establish one universal filter location. Guide provides a rollout-qualified exercise and honest missing-control fallback; tenant verification remains necessary.

Learn path landing page now lists four modules; individual modules and current total duration were not reviewed. O'Reilly/MeasureUp/Pluralsight public descriptions remain based on three domains and do not establish complete October coverage.

Udemy retrieval blocked; earlier listing metadata explicitly historical. Practice Assessment/video/partner-hub landing pages do not establish signed-in contents, video runtime, attendance or current seats.
Public blog texts reviewed; videos, linked demonstrations, customer performance and preview availability were not independently verified.
Same-context AI research/repair; independent and human review pending.
